target_roles.title: VP of Product Development
target_roles.rationale: Critical decision-maker for product innovation and portfolio strategy. Ultraflex's current outdoor banner materials last only 1-3 years versus Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan—this role owns the strategic opportunity to differentiate their outdoor graphics portfolio (building wraps, barricade graphics, outdoor signage) with premium, longer-lasting solutions. They just launched VorTex Soft Signage with four new ReSource products in November 2025, demonstrating active product line expansion. Tedlar enables them to: (1) command premium pricing through superior durability claims, (2) reduce warranty exposure and customer complaints about premature degradation, (3) differentiate against competitors in the outdoor graphics space, and (4) expand their addressable market into applications requiring 10+ year lifespans. Their emphasis on 'high-performing substrates' and harsh weather resistance shows product quality is already a strategic pillar—Tedlar amplifies this positioning while solving the durability gap that currently limits their outdoor product competitiveness.

target_roles.title: Director of Marketing
target_roles.rationale: Owns go-to-market strategy, competitive positioning, and customer messaging for Ultraflex's product portfolio. With active participation at ISA Sign Expo and PRINTING United (including an 80s arcade-themed booth at 2025 expo), this role is responsible for differentiating Ultraflex in a crowded large-format printing substrate market. Tedlar provides compelling marketing ammunition: the ability to claim industry-leading 12-20+ year outdoor durability vs. their current 1-3 year materials transforms their value proposition from commodity pricing battles to premium quality leadership. This role cares about: (1) competitive differentiation messaging that justifies higher pricing, (2) reducing negative customer feedback and warranty claims that damage brand reputation, (3) positioning products for premium architectural and transit segments (building wraps, transit interiors) where Tedlar's extreme durability unlocks new market opportunities, and (4) trade show storytelling—being able to showcase UV protection, graffiti resistance, and 20-year performance creates powerful booth demonstrations and sales collateral for their ISA/PRINTING United presence.

target_roles.title: Director of Operations
target_roles.rationale: Responsible for manufacturing efficiency, quality control, and warranty claim management across Ultraflex's 500,000+ square feet of global stock holding space and five North American warehouses. This role directly experiences the operational pain of product failures: customer complaints about fading, cracking, and weather damage on outdoor installations drive warranty replacements, damage customer relationships, and inflate operational costs. Tedlar solves their operational KPIs: (1) drastically reduce warranty claim rates by preventing UV degradation, yellowing, and weather-related failures that plague current 1-3 year outdoor materials, (2) lower total cost of quality through fewer returns and replacements, (3) improve customer satisfaction scores by delivering products that actually withstand harsh weather conditions as marketed, and (4) simplify quality assurance—Tedlar's proven 60+ year track record reduces variability and performance uncertainty. Given Ultraflex markets materials with 'additional strength and stability under harsh weather conditions,' this role needs protective films that actually deliver on that promise to reduce the operational burden of underperforming products in the field.
